title: consolidate-token-refresh-and-streaming-backpressure-across-sdks + minor ergonomic API surface changes
author: Maya Patel
description: Motivation: parity gaps between TypeScript, Python, and Go SDKs surfaced in customer work and internal examples. Specifically: (1) token refresh behavior differs under transient 401s which causes duplicated requests in streaming/long-poll client code; (2) retry semantics for idempotent vs non-idempotent calls were inconsistently documented and implemented; (3) streaming client lacked a programmable backpressure hook useful for browser/edge usage. This PR harmonizes policies and provides ergonomic helpers across the TS SDK surface to match behavior implemented earlier in Python/Go, adds tests, and bumps package.json minor version. Changes include: consolidated TokenManager with pluggable refresh strategy, new RetryPolicy enum (standard/strict/no-retry) with explicit idempotent flag on request helpers, StreamingClient.onBackpressure(callback) and an automatic low-water/high-water buffer that pauses the underlying network-readable stream when backpressure is signalled, clearer error classes (AuthError, RetryLimitError), and small ergonomic helpers: client.withDefaults() and client.streamLines() convenience. Checklist: - [x] design doc reviewed (ENG-4123) - [x] TypeScript implementation and unit tests - [x] e2e against local proxy that simulates 401 refresh races - [x] docs updated in README and changelog - [x] version bump to 0.8.2 - [x] reviewers sign-off The description below summarizes commits, changed files at a high level, CI results, and the review thread.
